statement: Top-1% wealth share at 2027Q4 >= 2025Q4 + 1 pp (Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts; 2027Q4 release)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2023. As of the last 2023 DFA vintage (released 2023-12-15), the top-1% share of net worth stood at 30.5% for Q3 2023, near but below its 2021 peak. The Q4 2023 value (~30%) was published in March 2024 and is excluded under the as-of rule.

items.summary: Bloc A central bank's distributional accounts (vintage of 2023-12-15): top-1% share of household net worth 30.5% in Q3 2023; top-0.1% share 13.9%.
items.detail: Federal Reserve Board DFA, as archived by ALFRED (St. Louis Fed) release vintage 2023-12-15, series WFRBST01134 (top 1%) and WFRBSTP1300 (top 0.1%), last observation Q3 2023 (verified via web_extract this run). Strict as-of vintage, not the later-revised series.
